contenders.handicapper_notes: Massive jockey upgrade to champion rider Zac Purton. Displayed sharp progression first-up when flashing late to finish 4th beaten only 2.5 lengths behind Kempes over this course and distance. Previously blew away rivals by 11 lengths in an August trial. Draws wide but possesses tactical positional speed to slot into midfield before utilizing Sha Tin generous 430m home straight.

Comes off a strong second-half run first-up on September 6, finishing 4th beaten just 1.75 lengths to Spicy Standard over 1200m. Retains featherweight impost of 120 lbs and secures top local pilot C Y Ho for in-form Pierre Ng barn. Well suited down the sweeping Sha Tin stretch second-up.

Proven Class 4 winner over this track and distance with an authoritative 1:10.2 victory last May. Showed good early dash when 5th beaten 2.5 lengths first-up in a fast-run sprint behind Happy Shooter. Matthew Chadwick retains the reins and maps into an ideal stalking trip from gate 6.

First-up for Mark Newnham after a three-and-a-half month spell. Tuned up nicely with an eye-catching barrier trial second on September 2 behind Handsome Blond. Has mixed it with strong company including Packing Glory and Alabama Song last season. Andrea Atzeni rides with confidence.

Resumes today and draws beautifully in barrier 3. Showed high ability last term with consecutive narrow runner-up finishes behind Aeroinvincible and Endeared over 1400m. Karis Teetan knows him well and he should get the perfect box-seat run behind the speed.

Resuming after three months off. Placed 3rd on debut beaten under a length to Packing Glory over 1200m. Apprentice Nichola Yuen provides a valuable weight claim. Capable of hitting the frame if securing running room from the wide barrier.
